name: Tío Conejo
scope: Dedicated audit. Wrote only this report and tests/character-audits/tioconejo.test.ts. No runtime, art, package, commits, server or child-agent changes.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: Preserved the original folklore arcade adaptation: long-eared white rabbit, sky-blue vest, red neckerchief, ochre trousers, evasive retreat and a single bouncing carrot. No new folklore claims or art alterations.

reference.title: Antonio Arráiz — Tío Tigre y Tío Conejo (edición Ministerio de Cultura, 2011)

validation.freshProcessRetest: Final12/12 run used a fresh tsx process. Initial assertions used a risky edge launch, assumed lifetime expiry instead of second-ground removal, miscalculated super damage and failed to start special in the CPU policy; corrected test setup/expectations, without runtime changes. After root camera fix, reran12/12 in another fresh process; full CPU/replay result remains identical. Earlier typecheck pass predates only this camera constant change.
